_comment: Curated list of trusted BRX resource-plugin source repos. A repo is verified by trusting its OWNER, not by auditing every file. Repos listed here appear in the editor's All Sources directory for one-click adding; only entries marked main:true are ALWAYS active sources and cannot be removed in the editor. Each repo's display name and icon come from its own repo.json (name/icon here are fallbacks for repos that lack one). Edited by hand by Atomic; listing a repo here is what makes it 'Verified'. REGISTRY IS EXCLUSIVE: the editor reads verified.json / featured.json / folders.json ONLY from this one hardcoded official repo. Every other repo (verified or user-added) contributes its mods/ folder and nothing else - a third-party repo cannot verify, feature, or folder-organize anything, even if it ships its own registry/ files, because the editor never fetches them.
